comment: cmd.c readchar_core() witness for EOF while repeating. #repeat (^A) replays the travel command with gi.in_doagain set, so getpos() reads its keys through pgetchar(), whose (char) result is EOF for 0377. NR_OF_EOFS is 20 in this SYSV build, so readchar_core() discards each 0377 and keeps the first other byte: the two 0377 bytes leave the cursor where it was and 'h' moves it.
